title: 易行物流智能工作台
flow: workbench -> dispatch -> save draft -> reject missing override -> select warned candidate with reason -> confirm -> show CONFIRMED and PENDING

assertions.detail: Draft shows DRAFT/NOT_QUEUED and explicitly reports no G7 command
Blockers and advice are separate; missing override reason is rejected in Chinese
Blocked candidate shows qualification and overlapping assignment reasons and cannot be selected
Confirmation shows CONFIRMED/PENDING and real G7 write remains closed
No application console warning or error after the complete interaction
All user-visible validation and candidate findings are Chinese

notValidated: real G7 write/readback, retry or reconciliation
